description: Bounded YOLO turn launched inside a private tmux server with a multiline prompt; shows item.started/item.completed for command_execution.
notes: command_execution items carry command, aggregated_output, exit_code (null while in_progress) and status
launched via: tmux new-session -d -s NAME -c DIR "<shlex-quoted argv> </dev/null >EVENTS 2>ERR; printf %s $? > RC"
the tmux session ends by itself when codex exec exits
